accept.title: Accept this order?
accept.description: The order will be marked accepted and funds will be held in escrow.

error.title: Could not accept order, please try again

start.title: Start this order?
start.description: The order will move to in progress. Only the provider can start an accepted order.

error.title: Could not start order, please try again

cancelOrder.title: Cancel this order?
cancelOrder.description: The order will be marked cancelled. Escrow funds may be refunded if already held.

error.title: Could not cancel order, please try again

acceptDelivery.title: Accept delivery and complete order?
acceptDelivery.description: The provider's delivery will be accepted, escrow funds released, and the order marked completed.

error.title: Could not complete order, please try again
